item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-11-10
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.

2. [Tech News] After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.

5. [Artificial Intelligence] Ready for a Siri AI agent? Apple under pressure to upgrade its assistant faster
